final_grader.about: Every run on the R8 build or later, graded again offline from its own exports by the final grader. T01's grader is at f66efa2, which credits a change record that names its change in shorthand (C9: cd49049, then f66efa2 for a value a word or two past the arrow and the verb of a paused flag); regraded with it, every T01 run from R8 to R16 keeps its row, gate and D12 except five of the six R14 Astra runs (C9, 0.97 to 1.00). The R15 runs were built at 1633470, whose grader is 689ab3b's; f66efa2 moves none of them. The R16 runs were built at f79c1db, whose grader is f66efa2's. T03's grader is at 758e202: 689ab3b's, with its judge on Claude Sonnet 5.5, the model T01's judge uses, so both tasks have one judge; every T03 run's C13 and C18 were judged again once with it (3 samples, the same prompts), and no T03 D12 or pass moved. A T01 judge row keeps its recorded votes when the final grader sends the judge the same prompt; otherwise it is re-judged once (3 samples) with the final prompt. Only grader changes can move a score: world and colleague fixes can't change what a recorded run did. losses says whose the points a run still loses are: fair (the agent's), env (a world or colleague defect fixed since), or mixed. T04's grader is at 98b9dcd and T05's at b4eb0d9, each its task's final grader after its last round; every T04 and T05 run was graded again with it from its own exports, a judge row keeping its recorded votes unless its text changed, when it was re-judged once (3 samples, Claude Sonnet 5.5).
